description: [CHECK · internal] The Conductor's shop-domain calc door: route an engineering claim + its numbers through the engine's manufacturing verifier -> seal -> hash-chained ledger, and report the disposition (CALCULATED/CONTROLLED/PROVISIONAL/OPEN). The engine verifies the calc; the engineer decides the label; nothing is invented. calc is an MFG_VERIFY spec: an RSS tolerance stack {tolerances,claimed_rss}, a sigma level {dpmo,claimed_sigma}, SPC limits {mean,sigma,claimed_ucl,claimed_lcl}, or Cp/Cpk {usl,lsl,process_mean,process_sigma,claimed_cp_capable}.
name: manufacture
